title: At 375x812 the Guidebook's first framing cuts off whole clusters (Health, Day job, Code)
detail: Steps: 1 open ?seed=1 at 375x812. 2 ••• > Open the Guidebook example > Replace. 3 Esc, press Home, wait 3.5s. Expected: whole memory framed or a way to tell clusters exist. Actual: screenPosition(health|job|checkout-js)=null (off screen), Home sits at x=17 (edge), Start here cluster only partly visible; a newcomer never sees 3 of 10 clusters without panning. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0003-guidebook/evidence/qa/L-375-today.jpg, L-375-last-year.jpg

title: Cluster hubs unlabelled / islands blur into one hairball in every lens at 1440
detail: Steps: open Guidebook, Home, press 1/2/3. Expected: clusters (Money, Home, Garden app, Day job, Health) legible as islands. Actual: only ~51 of 146 lights labelled (no overlaps, labelRects check = 0), Money/Garden app/Day job/Learning hubs often unlabelled (Last year shows neither Money nor Garden app), Home/Money/Files/Trip cluster in the centre merge, long Files-hub lines cross everything; memory fills only ~60% of the width. A newcomer cannot see '10 clusters'. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0003-guidebook/evidence/qa/L-1440-today.jpg, L-1440-last-year.jpg, L-1440-next-year.jpg

title: Notes promise the tax rate changes by lens, but taxPct is 5% Today and Last year
detail: Steps: Open Guidebook, press 2, search tax, open taxPct. g-lens says 'Rent, savings, the tax rate ... all change'; g-questions says 'What was the tax rate last year? (press 2, search tax)'. Expected: a visible difference from Today. Actual: 5 both; only Next year is 8, so the promised Last-year lesson shows nothing. Fix: make Last year 4 or reword.

title: 'What do I need before the trip?' answered by a trivial 1-hop route (Passport -> Trip to Lisbon)
detail: Steps: R, From Passport, To Trip to Lisbon, Enter. Expected: an answer to 'what do I need'. Actual: '1 hop, Passport -> Trip to Lisbon', 'Already one hop. Nothing shorter to learn.' It teaches nothing about routes. Better: click Trip to Lisbon (needs Passport, Leave days, Packing list). Similarly Bug #42 -> Weekly users is 1 hop Today (2 hops Last year, correct, but the note never says to compare lenses).

title: E6 perf e2e fails under CPU contention (likely the unidentified first-run failure)
detail: Run 1 of full e2e overlapped my own Playwright drivers: only failure '[E6] perf: 500 generated points hold >= 30 fps under SwiftShader', Received 21.9. Runs 2, 3, 4 run alone: 18/18 passed each. Not a Guidebook defect; the fps gate is load-sensitive, so verify can flake on a busy machine.

evidence: Island centres spread x1.4, timeline and flowcharts moved out with them; each island's hub now crowns its disc (open sky for its label); renderer gives label priority to the top 10 hubs when a memory has >120 lights (seed unaffected). G2 at 1440 now names Home, Money, Health, Learning, Day job, Garden app, Birthdays, lisbon-itinerary.
taxPct facets now 5/4/8 (Today/Last year/Next year); checkout last year = 69.4 USD; U-guidebook-4 and -6 updated.

Guide and Files-hub links weighted 0.25 so routes go through real things; notes now suggest Sam → Tax return (4 today via invoice, 5 last year via the night course) and Work laptop → Trip to Lisbon (3, via handbook and leave days). New U-guidebook-7 asserts named routes are ≥3 hops and never pass through guide notes or the Files hub.

Small screens: a memory with >120 lights (the Guidebook) now frames every island (bounding fit x1.06) instead of only what the pathways read; camera MAX_DIST 520→1600 so a portrait phone can fit it. New E8b asserts Health, Day job, checkout.js, Learning, Home, Money, Garden app and Launch are all on screen at 375x812 after Home. The 88-light seed keeps its spec §8 phone framing.
